verdict.rationale: Quo is a business texting and calling platform, so guided US A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration with approval-status tracking is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions 10DLC, brand or campaign registration, carrier vetting, or any registration-status view. The texting, number-setup and API items do not address this compliance workflow.

support.subject: As a founder, the product walks me through US A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration and shows the approval status
